text:
Type: small rectangular side table
Use: holding a lamp, books or drinks beside a sofa or bed; living room, bedroom, hallway
Style: rustic, Scandinavian, farmhouse
Materials: untreated solid pine with visible knots
Colors: light natural pine
Shape: narrow rectangular top with a thick edge, plain apron, four chunky square legs, simple bench-like silhouette, compact, medium visual weight
Feel: natural, sturdy, homey, warm
Goes with: light wood, white walls, wool and linen; cabins, cottages, Scandinavian bedrooms or living rooms
